question: Which is the second most populated state of India as per the Census 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra has the second-highest population after Uttar Pradesh as per Census 2011.**
 
• Next to UP, Maharashtra with a population of 11,23,72,972 is India's second-largest state in terms of population size and Bihar with 10,38,04,637 is in the third position.
 
• Maharashtra ranks 21st in India in terms of growth rate.
 
• Mumbai's negative growth rate in 2011 was - 5.75 percent.
 
• Thane is the biggest district with a population of 1,10,54,131.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the provisional results of the 2011 national census, Maharashtra is the second most populous state in India with a population of 112,374,333 (9.28% of India's population).
 
• The 2011 census for the Maharashtra state found **55% of the population to be rural with 45% being urban-based.**
 
• According to the 2011 census, Hinduism was the** principal religion in the state at 79.8 percent of the total population, while Muslims constituted 11.5 percent.**
 
• The sex ratio in Maharashtra was **929 females per 1000 males,** which was below the national average of 943.
 
• The literacy rate rose to 83.2 percent. Of this, male literacy stood at 89.82 percent and female literacy at 75.48 pm
